get.description: Retrieves status and metadata for a company-level unified upload by upload ID. Response includes upload_id, file_name, sanitized_file_name, content_type, file_size, status, and custom_metadata. Polling until status is available is mandatory before the file can be downloaded. Use this endpoint to poll upload progress (e.g. receiving → scanning → available) or inspect upload details after creation. When malware scanning is not enabled, status transitions directly from receiving → available.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the company.

parameters.name: upload_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the upload.

parameters.name: url_expires_in
parameters.description: Presigned URL TTL in seconds (for URL refresh). Minimum: 60, Maximum: 3600, Default: 3600

status.description: Upload lifecycle status. Scan outcomes are reflected here: 'scanning' while malware scan is in progress, 'available' when clean, 'failed' when infected or scan errored.

error.description: Present when status is 'failed', null otherwise. Describes the reason for failure.

type.description: scan_failure: the file is infected and the upload cannot be retried. scan_error: the scan engine failed and a new upload may succeed. file_type_not_allowed: the file contents are not an accepted type.

retryable.description: Whether retrying with a new upload_id may succeed. Always present when error is present.

segments.description: List of segments for multi-part uploads. Contains presigned URLs and metadata for uploading each segment. Empty list unless status is 'ready' or 'receiving'.

items.description: Segment information for uploading a file part

url.description: Presigned URL for uploading this segment

url_expires_at.description: Unix timestamp when the presigned URL expires

headers.description: Headers to include when uploading this segment

patch.description: Completes or updates progress for a company-level unified upload. Send part_etags: one ETag per segment (from each PUT response), same order as POST segments. Single-part: one ETag. Segmented: one per segment; null for not-yet-uploaded segments (partial progress). All non-null completes the upload; response includes upload_id and status: 'scanning' when a malware scan is pending, otherwise 'available'. Partial progress returns 'receiving'.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the company.

parameters.name: upload_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the upload.

requestBody.description: Request body for completing a file upload.

status.description: Upload lifecycle status, from the same vocabulary as the GET response. 'receiving' while segments are still outstanding, 'scanning' once complete and awaiting the malware scan verdict, 'available' when servable, 'failed' when the scan or the file-type check rejected it.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid request body or parameters

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to complete upload
